nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.summary: Records the release history from version 0.1.0 through 0.4.0, including training features, documentation, and security changes.

nodes.name: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
nodes.summary: Defines expected community behavior, incident reporting, and enforcement for project participation.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Explains the contributor workflow, development expectations, required checks, and pull-request checklist.

nodes.name: Launch LoRA Studio.cmd
nodes.summary: Windows launcher that installs or locates uv, synchronizes the main and native-Unsloth environments, then starts and health-checks the Streamlit application.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Batch control flow plus an embedded PowerShell command to manage a background Streamlit process and its health endpoint.

nodes.name: Launch LoRA Studio.sh
nodes.summary: Linux launcher that locates or installs uv, synchronizes the locked environment, manages a prior application process, and starts Streamlit on port 8504.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses strict Bash settings, a PID file, and HTTP health checks to make local startup repeatable.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview covering supported parameter-efficient training recipes, requirements, quick start, smoke testing, and links to detailed guides.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: States the vulnerability-reporting policy, supported versions, security controls, and safe-operation boundaries for local model training.

nodes.name: SETUP.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Windows and Linux installation guide covering uv environments, native Windows Unsloth, verification, smoke tests, maintenance, and troubleshooting.

nodes.name: TECHNICAL.md
nodes.summary: Technical handbook describing the application's architecture, data contracts, dataset and training pipelines, job lifecycle, trust boundaries, and extension points.

nodes.name: TUTORIAL.md
nodes.summary: Zero-to-mastery tutorial that teaches LLM post-training concepts and leads users through dataset, configuration, SFT, preference-training, evaluation, and repository-extension labs.

nodes.name: USAGE.md
nodes.summary: Operational guide for launching the application, selecting models and datasets, configuring training, monitoring jobs, locating artifacts, and resolving common problems.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Defines package metadata, supported Python range, runtime and development dependencies, build backend, console entry point, and the CUDA PyTorch index for uv.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PEP 621 project metadata and uv-specific source configuration to select the CUDA PyTorch package index.
